title: Open Shorebird diversification seed record, contract v3
description: Private release record of a hardened-diversified lineage (P5): the 32-byte random seed (canonical base64) and the id of the profile derived from it with open-shorebird.diversification.v1. Never committed (except the published DEVELOPMENT-ONLY fixture), never shipped, never an encryption key. Losing it means restoring this record or issuing a new native release with a new profile. See docs/HARDENING_CONTRACTS.md section 11.
